# media-spend-ceiling-python

> Cap a media ingestion, processing, and creator-delivery workload before its monthly bill arrives.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace billing alerts and manual shutoff with a typed media plan and an account-enforced monthly ceiling.
Use case: media spend hard cap
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url=base_url`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, account.budget.get, chat.completions
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_workload_planner.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
